final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_rem FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark HAVING AVG(remaincount) IS NOT NULL), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rem) AS m FROM per_order), s1 AS (SELECT p.* FROM per_order p, b1 WHERE p.avg_rem > b1.m), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rem) AS m FROM s1), s2 AS (SELECT s1.* FROM s1, b2 WHERE s1.avg_rem > b2.m) SELECT AVG(s2.avg_rem) AS avg_of_remaining, AVG(s2.avg_rem - b1.m) AS avg_excess_over_first, AVG(s2.avg_rem - b2.m) AS avg_excess_over_second FROM s2, b1, b2
